TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from BotFather. Create a bot with `/newbot`, then paste the token here. This value must stay secret.

SECRET.description: Random webhook secret sent by Telegram in `X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token`. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

HISTORY.description: KV namespace for recent Telegram messages. Messages are kept for 7 days by default.

COUNTERS.description: KV namespace for counters, caches, and lightweight bot state.

DB.description: D1 database for summaries, activity, and optional moderation/history tables.

AI.description: Workers AI binding used for chat summaries in the default free-first configuration.

LEGAL_RAG_INDEX.description: Optional Vectorize index for legal RAG experiments. The public default bot works with criminal/legal analysis disabled.
